changelog:
## v1.9.36

- Default Ribbon Badge: Bundle selected badge now defaults to the sleek top-right corner rotated ribbon
- Compact/Table Mode Refinements: Fixed price alignment and removed the top border on quantity and select buttons
- Equal Card Border Controls: Normal and selected states now share equal border width (default 2px) with subtle opacity for normal and active color for selected, eliminating card jumping/shifting
- Complete Box-Shadow Removal: Stripped all box-shadows across bundle cards, hover states, badges, and summary bars for a clean flat aesthetic
- Checkout Field Display Modes: Added control to toggle between Both Labels & Placeholders, Placeholders Only (hide labels), and Labels Only (hide placeholders)
- Bengali Default Headings: Defaulted billing heading to 'কাস্টমার তথ্য' and order review heading to 'আপনার অর্ডার'
- 3 Professional Summary Bar Layouts: Added layout picker for Modern Horizontal Inline Bar, Stacked 2-Tier Card, and Sticky Floating Bottom Bar
